dsh-j-space-warm README · 故障排查：| 现象 | 原因与处理 |
| --- | --- |
| 安装后选择器没有新预设 | 未重启 dsh（同步发生在宿主启动时）；确认安装命令输出无报错；查看宿主日志中的 `dsh-j-space-warm` 行 |
| 日志出现 `preset ... sync failed` | 同步或结构校验失败，按错误信息检查；预设文件损坏时先删除对应 `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/<id>` 再重启让插件重新同步 |
| 安装报 `pnpm not found` | 先安装 pnpm（`npm i -g pnpm`） |
| git 装配报 build 被 pnpm 阻止 | 按提示在 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的 `allowBuilds` 中放行 |
| 首轮没有热身轮 | 热身轮是「每个新顶层会话一次」：子代理、恢复的会话不触发；预插失败会优雅降级为无热身（任务照常，只是未锚定） |
| j-a-w(Bash) 在 Windows 上行为异常 | 该变体为跨平台设计，Windows 上持久 bash 依赖 PATH 中的 bash（WSL 垫片时可能启动 WSL bash）；Windows 请优先使用 j-a-w(Pwsh) |
| 选错变体 | 两个变体仅 shell 不同，其余完全一致；按环境选择即可 |

1. **已知密钥格式**：GitHub PAT（`github_pat_`/`ghp_`/`gho_` 等）、OpenAI/Anthropic key、AWS AKIA、Slack token、JWT、私钥块；

任何命中都会使构建失败（exit 1），保证**后续每次更新发布都自动复检**。`npm run audit` 可随时手动运行。

dsh-j-space-warm README · Presets：| Selector name | Bootstrap pair | Platform |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **j-a-w(Pwsh)** | `pwsh` + `str_replace_editor` (bash disabled throughout) | Windows |
| **j-a-w(Bash)** | persistent `bash` + `str_replace_editor` (pwsh disabled throughout) | Cross-platform |

The two variants differ **only in the tool surface** (initial tool and post-promotion resident set); all other files are byte-identical.

dsh-j-space-warm README · What it is：- **Two-phase anchored bootstrap**: the first model request exposes only the Minimal exact pair, a one-line persona, and no runtime context — anchoring the Minimal reasoning trajectory.
- **Warm-up round**: before the real task, one 0-task round in which the model calls the shell once, which triggers tool promotion — so the real task starts with the full tool surface, and the J-Space protocol is read in a clean round.
- **J-Space injection**: the cognitive-control protocol is injected on the first request and re-injected on every request carrying a real user message (`everyUserMessage`).
- **Security audit built in**: `npm run audit` scans for secrets/credentials/local-path leaks; wired into the build and the CI release workflow.
